tagline: Making homeownership a reality for the next generation of homebuyers
hero_kpi_rationale: Wholesale sales share increased by 6.5 percentage points to reach 15.7% in 2025, reflecting a business model adaptation strategy in response to residential affordability constraints and growing rental market demand.

kpis.name: Gross Margin
kpis.explanation: Share of revenue remaining after paying direct construction costs.
kpis.description: Gross margin declined to 20.7% in 2025 from 24.2% in 2024, pressured by costs and geographic mix.

kpis.name: Home Sales Revenue
kpis.explanation: Money generated from the sale of new homes.
kpis.description: Revenue decreased from $2.2B in 2024 to $1.7B in 2025, linked to lower home sales volume.

kpis.name: Homes Closed
kpis.explanation: Number of homes completed and sold within the year.
kpis.description: 4,685 homes closed in 2025 versus 6,028 in 2024, reflecting weaker demand and affordability constraints.

kpis.name: Average Selling Price
kpis.explanation: Average price at which a home is sold.
kpis.description: Average price decreased from $365,394 in 2024 to $364,035 in 2025, slightly down due to higher wholesale sales mix.

kpis.name: Active Communities Count
kpis.explanation: Number of active construction sites where homes are for sale.
kpis.description: Active communities decreased from 151 at end of 2024 to 144 at end of 2025, reflecting strategic adjustment.

kpis.name: Wholesale Sales Share
kpis.explanation: Proportion of homes sold in bulk to investors.
kpis.description: Wholesale sales represented 15.7% of closings in 2025 versus 9.2% in 2024, signaling rental market adaptation.

kpis.name: Net Income
kpis.explanation: Profit after all expenses and taxes.
kpis.description: Net income fell to $72.6M in 2025 from $196.1M in 2024, due to volume and margin decline.

kpis.name: Total Assets
kpis.description: Total assets extracted from yfinance over last 4 years.
kpis.signal: Total assets of 3.93B€ in latest year

kpis.name: Wholesale Sales Share
kpis.explanation: Proportion of homes sold in bulk to investors.
kpis.description: Wholesale sales represent a growing share of the business, increasing from 9.2% in 2024 to 15.7% in 2025.

kpis.name: Gross Margin
kpis.explanation: Share of revenue remaining after paying direct construction costs.
kpis.description: Gross margin declined from 24.2% in 2024 to 20.7% in 2025, reflecting cost pressures and mix dynamics.

risks.title: Affordability Constraints
risks.score_rationale: The company explicitly cites affordability constraints as a key factor impacting absorption rates and home closings. This macroeconomic factor has significant impact on volume and margins.

risks.title: Payment Default Risk
risks.score_rationale: The company has financing arrangements with banks to acquire land, which carries payment default risk. However, the amount at stake is limited.

risks.title: Warranty-Related Risks
risks.score_rationale: The company provides warranties to its customers, which carries risk of additional costs from claims. However, the company maintains a warranty reserve to cover these costs.

risks.title: Regulatory-Related Risks
risks.score_rationale: The company is subject to government regulations, which carries non-compliance risk. However, the company appears to be in compliance with current regulations.

risks.title: Competition-Related Risks
risks.score_rationale: The company operates in a competitive market, which carries market share loss risk. However, the company appears to have a solid market position.

ai_positioning.summary: LGIH does not mention artificial intelligence or machine learning in its 10-K/20-F filing.
